comment: Required evidence per GitHub issue #117: 'Add oracle self-tests that reject plausible wrong implementations' and 'A deliberately wrong sample candidate cannot pass by matching only the visible example.' Each control names one of oracle.py's BUGGY_MODES and one existing known-answer case (its 'exposing case') on which that bug's output provably differs from the correct oracle output. oracle.py --self-test runs every control and fails if a buggy output ever matches the correct output, which would mean the control failed to expose its bug.

controls.issue-117-anti-pattern: publishing a valid prefix after a later error
a candidate that hard-codes the visible published example and cannot pass a hidden input variant
